@graph.name: 4 Day Ijen, Papuma Beach, Tumpak Sewu & Bromo Journey from Surabaya

review.reviewBody: We had a great experience with Java Volcano. We were a group of 12 and visited Ijen, Tumpak Sewu Waterfall and Bromo. From the very beginning, Java Volcano organized everything (pick up from airport, stop when we needed, stuffs for the hike,etc.).\nEvery hotel were comfortable and clean, it is a excellent value for money, and one less mental burden for many a trip! Special thanks to our guide and photographer Yoga for his constant attention. And last but not least, thanks to our driver Johan, for his efficient driving, ensuring that we arrived before everyone else at the foot of the mountains!
